29-teams have played at least 4+ games so let’s take a look at a stat that we can actually take some meaning from and that’s how many three pointers teams are taking. 

This chart shows what percentage of a teams shots are 3’s - middy - rim

Half of Blazers & Hornets shots are 3’s (pink bar)

images.alt:
Stacked horizontal bar chart titled "Where Every Team's Shots Come From." Subtitle: Share of field goal attempts, sorted by three-point share, 2026-27 to date. Headers above the bars: Threes (pink, left), Mid-range (gray, center), At the rim (purple, right). Each of the 30 NBA teams has one bar split into three segments, with team logos at both ends. Values listed as threes, mid-range, at the rim:

Trail Blazers 50%, 21%, 29%
Hornets 50%, 25%, 26%
Nets 47%, 19%, 34%
Bulls 47%, 18%, 35%
Magic 46%, 24%, 30%
Celtics 46%, 22%, 32%
Suns 46%, 25%, 29%

Bucks 45%, 20%, 36%
Warriors 44%, 21%, 34%
Clippers 44%, 24%, 32%
Hawks 44%, 21%, 35%
Timberwolves 44%, 25%, 31%

Knicks 42%, 22%, 36%

Portland and Charlotte lead in three-point share at 50%. Oklahoma City and New Orleans are lowest at 35%. The Jazz take the most mid-range shots (37%), and the Pelicans take the most shots at the rim (44%). Data: Dunks & Threes. Viz: @Hoopinformatics.com on Bluesky.

quote.author: Hoop Informatics
quote.text:
With a majority of teams having played three games, it’s still too early to look at team stats as they are noisy and unreliable. 

In a couple days however, we will be able to analyze pace and 3pt attempt rate as after 4-games these stats pass the threshold where they become more real than noise.

images.alt:
Horizontal bar chart titled "# of Games Until We Can Trust Team Stats." A row of numbered circles across the top marks game numbers 1 through 30. Games 1 to 3 are shaded light purple and the rest dark purple. A dashed red vertical line runs down from game 3. Yellow bars show the game number at which each team stat becomes reliable, ordered from earliest to latest:

Pace: game 4
Three Point Attempt Rate: game 4
Free Throw Rate: game 5
Assist %: game 6
Opp 3pt Attempt Rate: game 7
Win %: game 8
Net Rating: game 8
Turnover %: game 10
Two Point %: game 11
Offensive Rebound %: game 11
True Shooting %: game 12
Offensive Rating: game 13
Opp Free Throw Rate: game 14
Defensive Rebound %: game 15
Opp Turnover %: game 15
Free Throw %: game 16
Defensive Rating: game 16
Three Point %: game 27

Footer: Via research by Krishna Narsu (@Knarsu3.bsky.social) posted to Nylon Calculus. Visual by Hoop Informatics.
